Messages.Author: Tommy Engvik
Messages.Body:
My friend and I were arguing about the use of "As you announce the
action" action modifiers. He claimed that you couldn't use both
Seduction and The Sleeping Mind, since you play both of them "as you
announce the action", and you only do this once.

In my opinion, you can play as many "as you announce the action"
action modifiers as you want (as long as they're not the same), like
Seduction, The Sleeping Mind, Repulsion etc.

Who's right?
--
